title: Chicken Nugget
description: This project adds chicken nuggets as a food item
body:
This project adds Chicken nuggets as a food item. The recipe is simple, a cooked chicken and one copper nugget, gold nugget, or iron nugget. You get 8 chicken nuggets. What does it do? it gives you 5 seconds of regeneration, and 10 seconds of slowness 1.
